**Drop 2.3.0** — the live room replaces 1:1 calls.

* Go live with video or voice: everyone with Drop open sees a tile and joins with one click, up to 10 people (`LIVE_MAX`).
* In the room: mute, camera, photo, invite others, lock the room, make it smaller and keep using Drop.
* Needs HTTPS; picture and sound stay in your network.

*Check for Updates* → *Update*.
